import sys

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    
    flag = False
    sb = []
    lst = []
    best = 0
    
    for j in range(len(s)):
        x = s[j]
        
        if x == '(':
            flag = True
            if len(sb) > best:
                best = len(sb)
            sb = []
        elif x == ')':
            flag = False
            if len(sb) > 0:
                lst.append(''.join(sb))
                sb = []
        elif x == '_':
            if not flag:
                if len(sb) > best:
                    best = len(sb)
                sb = []
            else:
                if len(sb) > 0:
                    lst.append(''.join(sb))
                    sb = []
        elif x.isalpha():
            sb.append(x)
    
    if len(sb) > best:
        best = len(sb)
    
    print(f"{best} {len(lst)}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
